days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Haus der Natur
stops.detail: The administration is located in the "Haus der Natur", the old station in Beuron, which is home to the Nature Park Association and the Nature Conservation Center.

stops.name: Erzabtei Beuron
stops.detail: The village emerged from the much-visited Beuron Archabbey.

stops.name: Knopfmacherfelsen
stops.detail: In this breakthrough valley of the still narrow river, mighty limestone cliffs were exposed: one of them is the Knopfmacherfelsen near Beuron.

stops.name: Donauradweg
